    a = np.asarray(a, np.float64); b = np.asarray(b, np.float64)

"""Generate seven pressure-controlled, lengthwise brush strokes for 花."""
import json,os,math,time,argparse
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import CubicSpline,PchipInterpolator
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session

OUT=Path('/app/output')
PX=.00022185986964255727

def root_samples(p,step=.6):
 p=np.asarray(p,float)
 t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1))]; length=t[-1];t/=length
 tt=np.linspace(0,1,max(40,int(length/step)))
 curve=CubicSpline(t,p[:,:2],bc_type='natural')
 xy=curve(tt); dv=curve(tt,1);dv/=np.linalg.norm(dv,axis=1)[:,None]
 width=np.maximum(0,PchipInterpolator(t,p[:,2])(tt))
 return xy,width,dv

def tip_path(s,p):
 xy,w,dv=root_samples(p)
 press=(w*PX+.0003)/1.187
 press[0]=0;press[-1]=0
 cm=press*100
 offset=np.maximum(0,(-.967*cm*cm+2.109994*cm-.036001727)/100)
 handle=xy+dv*offset[:,None]/PX
 x,y=s.geo.px_to_world(handle[:,0],handle[:,1])
 return np.c_[x,y,.020-press]

def run(paths,speed=.010,lead=.08,name='trial',score=True):
 s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json',render=False);s.reset();s.record_start();p=s.primitives()
 mv=p['move_tip']; hold=p['hold']
 for i,path in enumerate(paths):
  mv([*s.tip_pose()[0][:2],.065],speed=.06,settle=3)
  mv([-.100,.150,.060],speed=.12,settle=3)
  mv([-.100,.150,.024],speed=.04,settle=5)
  mv([-.100,.150,.060],speed=.05,settle=3)
  pts=tip_path(s,path)
  tangent=pts[1,:2]-pts[0,:2];tangent/=np.linalg.norm(tangent)
  start=pts[0].copy();start[:2]-=tangent*.004;start[2]=.028
  mv(start,speed=.12,settle=5)
  near=pts[0].copy();near[2]=.022
  mv(near,speed=.008,settle=5)
  # Uniform 3D speed, retaining the whole pressure profile.
  pp=np.vstack([near,pts,pts[-1]+np.r_[tangent*.001,.005]])
  dd=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(pp,axis=0),axis=1))]
  n=int(np.ceil(dd[-1]/speed/.05)); t=np.arange(1,n+1)*dd[-1]/n
  desired=np.array([np.interp(t,dd,pp[:,k]) for k in range(3)]).T
  allpos=np.vstack([near,desired]);vel=np.diff(allpos,axis=0)/.05
  for pos,v in zip(desired,vel):
   q,ok,err=s.ik(pos+lead*v)
   if not ok: raise RuntimeError(('IK failed',i,err,pos))
   s.step(q)
  hold(6)
  mv([*pts[-1,:2],.05],speed=.025,settle=5)
  Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(OUT/f'{name}.png')
  print('stroke',i+1,'steps',s.n_steps,'time',time.time(),flush=True)
 actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,OUT/'trajectory.npz')
 np.savez_compressed(OUT/f'{name}_ink.npz',ink=s.ink())
 data=s.strokes(); np.savez_compressed(OUT/f'{name}_samples.npz',**{str(i):v['samples'] for i,v in enumerate(data)})
 json.dump({'sha':s.state_sha(),'steps':s.n_steps,'length_mm':sum(v['length_mm'] for v in data)},open(OUT/f'{name}_local.json','w'),indent=2)
 if score:
  sc=s.status(); print(json.dumps(sc,indent=2),flush=True);json.dump(sc,open(OUT/f'{name}_score.json','w'),indent=2)
 return s

if __name__=='__main__':
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--paths',default=str(OUT/'paths.json'));ap.add_argument('--speed',type=float,default=.010);ap.add_argument('--lead',type=float,default=.08);ap.add_argument('--name',default='trial');ap.add_argument('--no-score',action='store_true');a=ap.parse_args()
